title_en: Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Illegal Medical Practice

articles.content_en:
Article 4 Where the illegal medical practice acts are the direct and main cause of the death of the patient, it shall be deemed as "causing the death of the patient" as prescribed in paragraph 1 of Article 336 of the Criminal Law.
Where the illegal medical practice acts are not the direct and main cause of the death of the patient, it may not be deemed as "causing the death of the patient" as prescribed in paragraph 1 of Article 336 of the Criminal Law. However, depending on the circumstances of the case, it may be deemed as "serious circumstances" as prescribed in paragraph 1 of Article 336 of the Criminal Law.

Article 5 Where a person commits the crime of illegal medical practice and concurrently constitutes other crimes such as the crime of producing or selling fake drugs, the crime of producing or selling substandard drugs, or the crime of fraud, the conviction and punishment shall be in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law that impose a heavier punishment.

Article 6 For the purposes of this Interpretation, the terms "medical activities" and "medical acts" shall be determined with reference to "diagnosis and treatment activities" and "medical cosmetology" in the Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Regulations on the Administration of Medical Institutions.
For the purposes of this Interpretation, the terms "mild disability, or organ or tissue damage resulting in general dysfunction" and "moderate or above disability, or organ or tissue damage resulting in severe dysfunction" shall be determined with reference to the Standards on Grading of Medical Accidents (for Trial Implementation).
